connector.name: CourtListener
connector.registryDescription: MCP for CourtListener: US federal and state opinions, dockets, judges, plus eCFR regulations.
connector.summary: Hosted at courtlistener-mcp.vaquill.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vaquill-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-CourtListener-Token
headers.description: Your free CourtListener API token from https://www.courtlistener.com/help/api/rest/. The server never stores your key.
